description: 10mΩ 2W Current Sense Resistor ±50ppm/℃ ±1% 2512 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount

provenance.pins: two-terminal shunt, symmetric package outline - no polarity

designVerdict: SELECTED as R1 only - the low-side shunt. The LM5069 current-sense role is gone.
notes: Value set by the INA226's +/-81.92 mV maximum differential input. At the 5 A full-scale bus current, 10 mOhm gives 50 mV - inside the range with headroom, and good resolution (2.5 uV/LSB means ~20,000 counts). A 20 mOhm part would give 100 mV and clip.
Dissipates 0.25 W at 5 A, comfortable in a 2512.
1% tolerance matters: it sets current-measurement accuracy directly, and that feeds the software power budget. The cheaper 5% (J) parts in the same family would make the budget 5% uncertain.
Alternative with better stock if needed: FPM253WFR005TM (C7420019), 5 mOhm, 39.8k - halves the signal to 25 mV and the dissipation to 0.125 W.

SCOPE REDUCED: this part was also R2/R3, the LM5069 sense resistors. The TPS16630 sets its current limit with a resistor on ILIM and needs no series sense element, so only the INA226's low-side shunt remains.
